greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lweNkosi uYesu Kristu, uthando lukaThixo, nokudibana koMoya oyiNgcwele nani nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, usivele imfesane. Kristu, usivele imfesane. Nkosi, usivele imfesane.
homily:
Kukho umfanekiso othile oza ezingqondweni zethu namhlanje. Cinga ngomntwana omncinci omi ecaleni kwendlela, ebukele iindiza ezinkulu zinyuka ziye esibhakabhakeni. UBenjamin Vo wayengumfana owayethanda ukujonga phezulu, owayethanda ukuphupha, owayethanda ukwazi ukuba izinto zisebenza njani. Wayengumfana owayehlala efuna ukufunda, ehlala efuna ukwakha, ehlala efuna ukunika. Namhlanje, njengoko sijonga amazwi kaHezekile kunye neVangeli, sikhunjuzwa ngento enzulu kakhulu: ukubaluleka kokuguquka, ukubaluleka kokutshintsha intliziyo, kunye nokubaluleka kokuvumelana noThixo ngendlela esiphila ngayo.

Hezekile uthi, 'Isi-sikhumbuzo sokuba indlela yeNkosi ayilunganga? Hlalani niphulaphule, ndlu yakwaSirayeli: Ngaba yindlela yam engalunganga, okanye ngaba ziindlela zenu ezingalunganga?' La magama anokuziva enzima, kodwa azisa inyaniso ebalulekileyo. UThixo akasigwebi ngezinto ezingaphandle kolawulo lwethu. UThixo akasigwebi ngenxa yezifo okanye iintlekele ezisihlaselayo. Kodwa uThixo usimema ukuba siphile ngendlela esivula iintliziyo zethu kuye, nokuba siphila ngothando, nangobubele, nangokholo. UBen wayengumfana owayeyiqonda le nto. Wayengumfana owayephila ngothando, owayephila ngobubele, owayephila ngoxolo. Wayengumfana owayesoloko ecinga ngabanye, njengaxa wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, akazange ayikhuphule ngokoqobo, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Wayengumfana onikela ngayo yonke into yakhe. Lo moya wokunika waba yindlela yakhe yokuphila.

Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba sele kuphele iinyanga ezintathu uBen esishiye, kwaye indlu isenokuziva ithule ngendlela ebuhlungu kakhulu. Xa ucinga ngaloo mntwana owayeza kuwe ekuseni, esithi 'Molo, Ba,' ngesandla esithembaneyo, akukho xesha lonyaka linokuzisa ukuthula ngokukhawuleza. Usizi alulandeli ikhalenda. Luza ngexesha lalo, lunzima, lufuna indawo. Ndaye ndifuna ukuba uthethe inyaniso yale ntliziyo yakho namhlanje. Akukho nqaku lokuthi uphosile okanye wenze kakubi. Ukugula akwanga kwenzeka ngenxa yezinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala. Masikhuphe lo mthwalo wokuzisola emajukujukwini eentliziyo zenu namhlanje, kuba iNkosi ayisigwebi ngezifo. Ezinye izinto zenzeka ngaphandle kwamandla ethu onke, kwaye akukho buqili bomntu obunokukuthintela oku. Unalo uthando lukaThixo, kwaye uBen, uBen owayesoloko elungele ukunika, ukunika konke ngaphandle kokubala, uqhubeka enibukele ngothando olungagungqiyo.

KwiVangeli, uYesu ubuza abafundi bakhe: 'Amanzi ayinkqubo enobunzulu obungenakulinganiswa, kodwa uThixo usimema ukuba siphile ngendlela esivula iintliziyo zethu kuye.' UYesu ubalisa ngeendodana ezimbini. Omnye uthi 'ndiya kuhamba' kodwa akahambi, omnye uthi 'andiyi kuhamba' kodwa emva koko uyatshintsha, uyahamba uyokusebenza. UYesu ubuza: 'Ngubani owenza intando kayise?' Le yimibuzo eyimfuneko kuthi namhlanje. Ngaba siphila ngendlela esivula iintliziyo zethu kuThixo? Ngaba siphila ngendlela esivula iintliziyo zethu kwabanye? UBen wayengumfana owayeyiqonda le nto. Wayengumfana owayephila ngothando, owayephila ngobubele, owayephila ngoxolo. Wayengumfana owayesoloko ecinga ngabanye, njengaxa wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, akazange ayikhuphule ngokoqobo, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Wayengumfana onikela ngayo yonke into yakhe. Lo moya wokunika waba yindlela yakhe yokuphila.

Ryan, mfowethu omncane, uBen uyamthanda. Ungalokothi uzive ungedwa. UBen uyaqhubeka ehamba nawe, ekukhathalele, kwaye uthando lwenu aluzange lufe. Vumela uYesu abe lulwalwa lwakho namhlanje. Thatha igama likaBen, thandaza kuye uThixo, kwaye uqhubeke uphila ngesibindi, wazi ukuba akukho lizwi linye lothando olulahlekileyo phambi koThixo. UBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya ngomsebenzi wakhe wothando, njengaloo mthombo wamanzi eCà Mau, olethela ubomi kwabanye. Uthando lwakhe aluzange luphele; lusaqhubeka lukhanya njengolwandle olukhulu. UBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo, kwaye nathi, simele siphile ngaloo ndlela—ngothando olungagciniyo, ngoxolelo olungapheliyo, nangokholo olomeleleyo. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Uthando lwakho lulukhanya olungasoze lwavaleleka. Uthando lwakho, njengaloo mthombo wamanzi, luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye luyaqhubeka lukhanyisa iindlela zethu. Khumbula ukuba uBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo, kwaye nathi, simele siphile ngaloo ndlela—ngothando olungagciniyo, ngoxolelo olungapheliyo, nangokholo olomeleleyo. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu, ndiyakholelwa ukuba ukhona ngenene kule Sacrament engcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwako konke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela kule Sacrament, nceda uze kum ngomoya nangokomoya. Ndiyakwamkela ngathi sele ukhona, kwaye ndizibophelela kuwe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahluke kuwe. Amen.
closing: INkosi mayisibuyisele uxolo lwayo, kwaye isigcinele ubomi obungunaphakade. Hamba ngoxolo.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen nabo bonke abashiyileyo, ukuze baphumle elukhanyisweni lukaKristu.
Sithandazela bonke abasizileyo, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele kwaye abanike ithemba.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Utsho uYehova ukuthi: Nithi, Indlela yeNkosi ayilunganga. Ncedani niphulaphule, ndlu yakwaSirayeli: Ngaba yindlela yam engalunganga, okanye ngaba ziindlela zenu ezingalunganga? Xa umntu olungileyo etshikila ebulungiseni bakhe, enze ubugwenxa, afa, uya kufela ubugwenxa abenzileyo. Kodwa xa umntu ongendawo etshikila ebugwenxeni bakhe, enze okusesikweni nokulungileyo, uya kuwusindisa umphefumlo wakhe; ngokuba etshikile, esuka kuzo zonke izono zakhe azenzileyo, uya kudla ubomi, akayi kufa.

readings.label: Ihubo lokuphendula
readings.text: Khumbula imfesane yakho, Nkosi. Zazise iindlela zakho, Yehova; ndifundise imikhondo yakho. Ndikhokele enyanisweni yakho, undifundise; ngokuba unguThixo osindiso lwam. Khumbula imfesane yakho, Nkosi. Khumbula imfesane yakho, Yehova, nenceba yakho; ngokuba zikwasephakadeni. Izono zobutsha bam nezikreqo zam uze ungazikhumbuli; undikhumbule ngenceba yakho, ngenxa yobubele bakho, Yehova. Khumbula imfesane yakho, Nkosi. Ulungile uthe tye uYehova; ngako oko ubafundisa aboni indlela. Ubakhokhela abathobekileyo esikweni, ubafundisa abathobekileyo indlela yakhe.

readings.label: Isifundo sesibini
readings.text: Bazalwana: Ukuba kukho naluphi na ukhuthazo kuKristu, naluphi na uthuthuzelo lothando, naluphi na udlelwano loMoya, naluphi na uvelwano nemfesane, yenzani uvuyo lwam lube luphelele ngokuba nibe nengqiqo inye, nibe nothando olunye, nibe nentliziyo inye, nicinge nto inye. Ningenzi nto ngambambano okanye ngobulungisa bobuze; kodwa ngokuthobeka kwentliziyo, omnye makamthabathe omnye njengomkhulu kunaye, elowo angajongi okwakhe, kodwa ajonge nokwabanye. Nibe nengqiqo leyo ebeyinayo uKristu Yesu: yena, ebekumfanekiselo kaThixo, akathi ukulingana noThixo kukulwaphulo-mthetho okumele ukubanjwa; kodwa wazihluba, wathabatha umfanekiselo womkhonzi, waba sekufaneni kwabantu; efumaneke enjengomntu ngokubonakala, wazithoba, waba ngothobelayo kwada kwasekufeni, ewe, kude kuse ekufeni emnqamlezweni. Kungako uThixo amphakamisileyo ngokugqithiseleyo, wamnika igama elingaphezu kwawo onke amagama; ukuze ngegama likaYesu amadolo onke agobe, awasezulwini, nawasemhlabeni, nawaphantsi komhlaba; nolwimi lonke luvume ukuba uYesu Kristu uyiNkosi, kuzuko lukaThixo uYise.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UYesu wathi kubabingeleli abayintloko nakubadala babantu: 'Nithini na nina? Umntu wayeneendodana ezimbini. Waya kowokuqala wathi, Nyana, hamba uye kusebenza emdiliyeni namhlanje. Waphendula wathi, Andiyi kuhamba; kodwa emva koko wazisola, wahamba. Waya nakowesibini, wathetha okufanayo. Waphendula wathi, Ndiya kuhamba, nkosi; kodwa akahamba. Nguwuphi na kwaba babini owenze intando kayise?' Bathi kuye, 'Owokuqala.' UYesu wathi kubo, 'Inene, ndithi kuni, abaqokeleli berhafu namahenyukazi bangena ebukhosini bukaThixo ngaphambi kwenu. Kuba uYohane weza kuni ngendlela yobulungisa, nani anikholwanga nguye; kodwa abaqokeleli berhafu namahenyukazi bakholwa nguye; nani, nakubona oko, anizisolanga emva koko, ukuze nikholwe nguye.'

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm
